01 — Introduction

A recovery partner built for larger commercial balances

To the Surge credit and collections team — nationwide business-to-business invoices, balances above $25,000, and a clear standard: actual recovery results, total cost and quality of account management. That is the standard we would like to be measured against.

When results are not where you want them, the question is what changes. Larger commercial balances reward early, documented, persistent work — and a partner who is straight about what recovers and what does not.

Southwest Recovery Services is an outsourced receivables recovery partner working business receivables on pure contingency since 2004, with recovery reach across all 50 states. You place accounts through a secure portal, we work them, and you follow every account in real time. No recovery, no fee.

03 — Your questions, answered

Your six questions — answered directly

Taken in the order you asked them, with the details that matter for a national staffing creditor moving off a law-firm incumbent.

Your questionSouthwest Recovery Services
Capabilities & recurring placementsCommercial B2B recovery nationwide, for mixed portfolios that include larger claims, with recurring placements and many accounts worked at once through one portal. We send current state licensing and bonding documentation with our written follow-up.
Fees & pricingPure contingency — $0 upfront, no retainer, no monthly minimum. You pay a pre-agreed percentage only of what we actually recover. We quote your rate once we have seen a representative sample of your aging, and the written terms set out how fees apply to principal, contractual interest, late charges and any legal costs.
Contract interestWe review the interest and late-fee provisions in your contracts alongside the sample and pursue them where the contract and state law support it. State-by-state enforceability and the reporting you want on principal versus interest are worked through on the call.
Strategy & reportingEvery account is scored first, then worked with compliant outreach across text, email, live and AI-assisted calls, voicemail drops and mailed notices, timed to when the account engages. The secure 24/7 portal shows account activity and reports on demand. A dispute pauses recovery rather than ending it: we validate the invoice against your contract, billing and timesheet or delivery records.
Legal escalationWe review each account for escalation with you, including approvals and costs, before anything is filed. Our legal research gateway supports entity, judgment and bankruptcy checks so escalation decisions rest on facts.
Trial placement & termsA limited test batch is a sensible way to start and we are glad to set one up. The service agreement and written terms, including minimums and withdrawal terms, come with our follow-up.

The age advantage

Why fresh commercial invoices recover best

A commercial balance is most collectible while it is fresh; every month it ages, contact data goes stale and leverage erodes. Mixed aging is normal — the earlier an invoice is placed with clean documentation, the better the odds.

The age curve

Fresh accounts (under ~90 days past due) often resolve in 30–60 days; balances that sit a year collect a fraction of that.

The standing rule

A fixed “place at 90 days” policy recovers materially more than letting balances drift toward write-off — and on contingency there is no cost to placing.

Recovery figures vary by portfolio; SWRS gives an honest, age-based read on a representative sample before any accounts are worked.

05 — Built for B2B trade receivables

Cutting the days between invoiced and paid

Days Sales Outstanding and Average Collection Period measure the same thing: how long earned revenue sits as a receivable before it becomes cash. Median DSO runs about 43.5 days and the strongest quartile collects in roughly 25 — every month past that erodes both recoverable value and working capital.

Aged commercial invoices

Persistent multi-channel outreach and commercial skip tracing for customers who have gone quiet on larger balances.

Disputed & contested invoices

Documentation-driven validation — contracts, invoices, timesheets — that separates a genuine dispute from a stall tactic.

Interest & late charges

Contract interest and late-fee provisions reviewed with your sample and pursued where the contract and state law support it.

Nationwide reach

Recovery across all 50 states from offices across 8 states — built for a customer base as widespread as yours.

06 — AI-powered collections

Recovery run on an AI-driven platform — Aktos

Every account SWRS works runs on Aktos, a next-generation, AI-driven collections platform — with compliance built into the workflow, not bolted on afterward. It’s how a boutique, people-first agency delivers enterprise-grade speed, consistency, and auditability.

AI workflow automation

Repetitive steps are automated and every account is scored and routed by predicted payment likelihood — so the right strategy reaches the right account first, without manual queue-picking.

Omnichannel outreach

Coordinated email, SMS, and voice, timed to when a debtor is most likely to engage — replacing high-friction call blasts with respectful, data-driven contact.

Compliance built in

FDCPA, Reg F, and TCPA guardrails are enforced inside the automation, with phone-number and consent checks before outreach — documented and defensible on every account.

Real-time dashboards

You see status, segmentation, and recovery performance on your portfolio in real time — full transparency, not a monthly PDF.

API-first intake

Secure SFTP/API placement means accounts start working without data lag — roughly 50% faster acknowledgment and validation of new placements.

Data-driven scoring

Dynamic scoring and segmentation predict payment likelihood and concentrate effort where recovery is most achievable — earlier intervention that trims DSO and reduces disputes.

The result is the combination clients rarely get from a legacy agency: faster cash and cleaner compliance at the same time. Automation accelerates recovery and standardizes documentation, while empathy-first, data-driven contact protects your brand and keeps disputes and complaints low.

07 — Meet the founder

Built by a collector with 30 years on the phones — not a CEO with zero collection experience

Steven Dietz
Founder & Chief Executive Officer
Featured in USA Today, International Business Times & Financial Services Review — Top AR Management Service, 2025 · ACA International member.

Steven Dietz didn’t come to collections from the corner office — he came from the phones. He started as a collector and credit analyst before he was 20, was tapped by Aaron’s to train collectors across 100+ locations, and has spent nearly 30 years in receivables. Along the way he became convinced the industry’s bad reputation was a choice, not a requirement: businesses get paid faster when recovery is built on listening and respect rather than aggressive calls and empty threats.

He founded Southwest Recovery Services in 2004 on that principle — a national, family-owned receivables partner that treats every debtor as a person and every client relationship as worth protecting. Two decades later he still coaches the teams and works accounts personally — an operator who has actually done the job, not a manager who has only overseen it.

Regardless of the means of recovery, our focus is always on preserving goodwill and representing the client professionally.
— Steven Dietz, Founder & Chief Executive Officer, Southwest Recovery Services
